data.title: 隐德来希 · 留声机前的静止黑胶
data.action: 倚在复古大喇叭留声机旁，手里拿着刚刚停转的黑胶唱片，眼神深邃优雅，指尖轻轻抚过唱针
data.location: 罗德岛私人典藏音乐室红木矮几旁
data.lighting: 黄铜留声机大喇叭反射出的暗金色暖光，与阴郁深海色调在黑色真丝衬裙上交织
data.mood: 典雅深邃、艺术沉醉、独属于午夜的静止旋律
data.description: 音乐室内的黑胶唱针缓缓滑落回原位。深海猎人兼大提琴家隐德来希换上一袭不对称剪裁的灰黑暗纹真丝衬裙，赤足踩在波斯织毯上。她斜倚在老式黄铜留声机前，修长的手指轻托着旋转完毕的唱片边缘，灰紫色的长卷发如深海海藻般舒展。她偏头凝望着陪伴在侧的你，眼眸中流淌着未散的狂想曲余韵——「音乐停下了……但留在心房里的振动，还在继续。博士，你觉得刚才那段华彩，能够触及深海的真正寂静吗？」
data.promptProse: Entelechia lingers beside a vintage brass-horned gramophone inside a quiet midnight music room, barefoot on a woven rug in an asymmetric charcoal-and-black silk jacquard chemise with brass ring clasps. Holding the edge of a freshly stopped vinyl record as her calm red eyes meet the viewer, she catches muted golden highlights across the dark silk.
data.animaCaption: Standing barefoot on a patterned rug beside a brass-horned gramophone in an asymmetric charcoal-black silk chemise, she cradles a stopped vinyl record by its edge and tilts her head calmly toward the viewer. Muted golden reflections from the antique horn warm the dark silk folds.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an asymmetric charcoal-grey and black silk jacquard chemise with brass ring clasps and a flowing handkerchief hem.
